name: air_cooler_infographic

Show a clear airflow path with arrows: hot dry air entering from the sides through the wet cooling pads, then blue-tinted cool air exiting the front grill. Step-by-step workflow: the cooler sits at center-left with four numbered stages around it - (1) water fills the tank, (2) the pump lifts water onto the cooling pads, (3) the fan draws hot air through the wet pads where evaporation absorbs heat, (4) moist cool air is pushed into the room. Add a small thermometer icon showing the temperature drop (e.g., 40 degrees C to 25 degrees C) and a humidity note. Environment: clean white studio background with a soft light-blue gradient panel behind the cooler. Composition: horizontal infographic layout, cooler centered as the hero element, bold blue airflow arrows, components connected to text labels with thin leader lines. Labels in exact wording: Water Tank, Water Pump, Wet Cooling Pads, Fan and Motor, Hot Air In (red arrow), Cool Air Out (blue arrow), Evaporation Equals Cooling. Use a modern clean sans-serif font for all labels. Visual style: flat 2D vector illustration infographic, modern education design, consistent icon style, rounded shapes. Lighting: flat even illumination, no shadows, no 3D depth. Colors: white and light gray base, accent blue for cool air and water, warm orange-red for hot air, subtle teal highlights. Technical details: crisp vector lines, high contrast, scalable clean layout. Constraints: do not include any other text, logos, watermarks, or brand names; no spelling errors; do not mix photographic elements or 3D renders; keep the diagram simple enough for a general audience.
